leadTemperatureStages.label: Hot List
leadTemperatureStages.definition: Ready to buy this week, just needs final push or call, you expect them to close now

leadTemperatureStages.label: Warm List
leadTemperatureStages.definition: Interested but not 100% ready, needs follow-up/nurture, likely to close within 30 days

leadTemperatureStages.label: General List
leadTemperatureStages.definition: "Okay" leads, not ready, needs a lot of work, might close after 30+ days, if ever

leadTemperatureStages.label: Disqualified
leadTemperatureStages.definition: They are not a fit for the offer, now or in the future. Could be due to budget, country, role or mindset.

leadTemperatureStages.label: Call No Show
leadTemperatureStages.definition: Prospect didn't show for the booked call.

sequenceRouting.notes: Disqualified/No-show/Cancelled: no sequence in this file yet — per the SOP, disqualified just gets logged, and no-show/cancelled needs a separate short sequence that hasn't been written yet.

sequences.name: Hot List SOP 1
sequences.useWhen: Prospect showed high intent, had the budget or path to get it, verbalized the pain and desired outcome, objection was timing/logistics/"need to think about it", felt ready but didn't click go — and did NOT set a follow-up to reconnect.
sequences.goal: Closing the deal within 7 days using a personalized and low-pressure approach built around the lead's reason for not committing.
sequences.notes: Use SMS or Email — match whichever channel they respond to best (if they answered SMS before, use SMS). Mirror their words. Don't push, ask questions. Leave space for them to sell themselves. Add voice notes through SMS to get more emotional buy-in. Keep it YOU-driven, not product-driven.

sequences.name: Re-Offer (Incognito)
sequences.useWhen: Send to the hottest leads only: people who had a sales call and didn't buy, or people who were very interested but never made it to a call.
sequences.timing: Minimum 7 days after the last serious sales interaction. Sweet spot: around day 14. Latest while they're still "hot": within 30 days.
sequences.frequency: Run 1–2 times per month as new hot leads age into that 7–30 day window.
sequences.how: 1:1 DMs, emails, or texts that use the script structure below. No big public announcement — under-the-radar personal outreach.
sequences.notes: Public version (not included here): a full promo strategy targeted everywhere — FB/IG posts, daily CTAs/stories until the promo ends, blasted to all emails, can go to colder leads too. To avoid burning leads, run every 2–3 months. Keep the tone casual — don't make it sound copy-pasted or robotic; use your own language.
